_standards: See STANDARDS.md. Requirement classes and readiness tiers are enforced by catalog/schema/entity_schema_3.0.json.
_readiness_note: STUB. Structure only. Every aircraft-specific value is a declared gap or is not recorded at all - nothing here has been sourced. The catalog reports this entity as unmodelable and the gate REFUSES it. That is correct behaviour, not a defect to work around by filling fields with plausible numbers.
_stub_note: Deliberately thin, and several optional keys are ABSENT rather than declared - they report as NOT RECORDED, in contrast with UAS-QUAD-DJI-MINI4PRO where every gap carries a todo. Public performance data for Blue UAS platforms is thinner than for commercial aircraft and some figures are not published at all, so a low readiness tier here may be the honest steady state rather than a temporary condition.

mass_kg.todo: Takeoff weight including battery. Skydio product documentation or the Blue UAS listing.

propeller_diameter_m.todo: Propeller diameter. Needs the propeller part number from a parts listing, then convert from inches.

rotor_count.note: Definitional from the category, not a measurement.

capacity_wh.todo: Pack energy in Wh. Manufacturer battery specification.

voltage_full_v.todo: Charge voltage limit. Manufacturer battery specification, or cell count times the per-cell limit for the stated chemistry.

performance_published._note: No performance figure has been sourced yet.

max_hover_time_min.todo: Hover endurance. THIS IS THE CALIBRATION ANCHOR - no parameter can be fitted without it.

max_flight_time_min.todo: Flight endurance, together with the speed it was measured at.

max_speed_ms.todo: Maximum speed. Sets the best-range search ceiling.

usable_energy_fraction.todo: Reserve policy. Likely inherited from doctrine rather than from the vendor, but adopt it explicitly.

operational_overhead_factor.todo: Needs an independent measured endurance to compare against the published figure.

air_density_kg_m3.note: Environmental constant, not an aircraft property.

equivalent_flat_plate_area_m2.todo: Airframe-specific drag area. Estimate from frontal area and a bluff-body Cd, or identify it from a tilt-versus-wind sweep the way test_3b_wind.py does for the simulator's airframe.

figure_of_merit.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
figure_of_merit.note: Class-typical modelling assumption carried at the same literature citation the rest of the catalog uses. It is NOT a measurement of this airframe and must be revisited before this entity is briefed.

motor_esc_efficiency.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
motor_esc_efficiency.note: Class-typical modelling assumption, not a measurement of this airframe.

propulsive_efficiency.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
propulsive_efficiency.note: Class-typical modelling assumption, not a measurement of this airframe.

avionics_power_w.todo: Airframe-specific. Needs a hover current draw measurement, or a teardown estimate of the compute, radio and gimbal loads. Skydio's onboard autonomy stack likely draws more than a comparable commercial aircraft, so do not carry the Mavic 3 figure across.

thrust_coefficient.todo: Propeller-specific C_T. Needs the propeller model, then a UIUC propeller database lookup or a static thrust bench test.

profile_power_mu_factor.source: Standard rotorcraft profile power growth form P = P0 (1 + 4.65 mu^2)

calibration._note: Declared intent. Nothing can be fitted until the hover anchor and the physical parameters exist.
